bindings.name: doc.id
bindings.note: Re-sanitised after the script runs, so it stays Meilisearch-safe.

bindings.name: doc.title
bindings.note: Set it to () to clear the title.

bindings.name: doc.fields
bindings.note: Structured attributes. Most operations act here.

bindings.name: price
bindings.note: A bare name that is not a variable reads the field of that name.

gotchas.title: Some string methods edit in place
gotchas.body: trim(), replace(), pad(), truncate(), clear(), make_upper() and make_lower() change the string and return (). Write doc.content.trim(); on its own, then test doc.content.is_empty(). to_upper() and to_lower() return a new string.

gotchas.title: A variable beats a field
gotchas.body: After let price = 5; the name price means 5, even if the document has a price field. Use doc.fields.price to reach the field.

gotchas.title: Set takes one expression
gotchas.body: The builder's Set is a single expression: no let, no semicolons, no loops. Switch to Code for anything longer.

gotchas.title: round takes the decimals
gotchas.body: Use round(x, 2). rhai's own round(x) accepts only floats.

gotchas.title: id, title and content in filters
gotchas.body: In a filter, the names id, title and content mean the document's own attributes, not fields.
